title: EU Negotiators Agree on a 2027 Budget, with Formal Approval Still Ahead

sources.name: Council of the European Union
sources.title: EU budget for 2027: Council and Parliament reach agreement

sources.name: Irish Presidency of the Council of the European Union
sources.title: Tánaiste announces agreement on EU’s 2027 budget

paragraphs.en: On November 11, 2026,
European Union negotiators reached a deal
paragraphs.zh: 歐盟談判代表就一項方案達成協議，

paragraphs.en: on the bloc's budget for 2027.
paragraphs.zh: 內容是歐盟2027年的預算。

paragraphs.en: The Council and the European Parliament
paragraphs.zh: 歐盟理事會與歐洲議會

paragraphs.en: agreed on €199.7 billion in commitments
paragraphs.zh: 同意編列1,997億歐元的承諾額度，

paragraphs.en: and €211.5 billion in payments.
paragraphs.zh: 以及2,115億歐元的支付額度。

paragraphs.en: These figures describe different parts of the plan,
paragraphs.zh: 這兩項數字描述的是計畫中的不同部分，

paragraphs.en: rather than two separate funds to add together.
paragraphs.zh: 而不是兩筆可以直接相加的獨立資金。

paragraphs.en: The distinction matters because public projects
paragraphs.zh: 這項區分很重要，因為公共計畫

paragraphs.en: can continue for several years.
paragraphs.zh: 可能持續好幾年。

paragraphs.en: A commitment is a legal promise to provide funding.
paragraphs.zh: 承諾額度是依法承諾提供資金的額度。

paragraphs.en: The money may be paid later,
paragraphs.zh: 這筆錢可能稍後才支付，

paragraphs.en: as work moves forward.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著工作進展陸續撥付。

paragraphs.en: Payments cover money due during the budget year,
paragraphs.zh: 支付額度則涵蓋預算年度內應支付的款項，

paragraphs.en: including obligations agreed in earlier years.
paragraphs.zh: 也包括過去年度已同意承擔的義務。

paragraphs.en: A higher payment total does not necessarily mean
paragraphs.zh: 較高的支付總額不一定表示

paragraphs.en: that more new promises are being made.
paragraphs.zh: 當年度作出了更多新的承諾。

paragraphs.en: For example, imagine a research project
paragraphs.zh: 例如，設想有一項研究計畫，

paragraphs.en: that receives a funding commitment in one year
paragraphs.zh: 在某一年取得資金承諾，

paragraphs.en: but carries out work over several years.
paragraphs.zh: 卻需要數年才能執行完畢。

paragraphs.en: Payments could follow as that work progresses.
paragraphs.zh: 款項可能隨著工作進度陸續支付。

paragraphs.en: This is an illustration of the accounting distinction,
paragraphs.zh: 這只是用來說明會計區分的假設例子，

paragraphs.en: not a description of a particular award
paragraphs.zh: 並非描述某一筆特定的補助，

paragraphs.en: in the newly negotiated budget.
paragraphs.zh: 也不是指新近協商預算中的個別項目。

paragraphs.en: Ireland, which chaired the Council negotiations,
paragraphs.zh: 主持理事會談判的愛爾蘭

paragraphs.en: said the deal would support a wide range of programmes.
paragraphs.zh: 表示這項協議將支持多種計畫。

paragraphs.en: They include farming and fishing communities,
paragraphs.zh: 其中包括農業與漁業社群，

paragraphs.en: as well as education, research, businesses, and infrastructure.
paragraphs.zh: 也涵蓋教育、研究、企業及基礎設施。

paragraphs.en: Its announcement linked the agreement to greater certainty
paragraphs.zh: 愛爾蘭的公告指出，這項協議能提高確定性，

paragraphs.en: for governments and organisations planning the year ahead.
paragraphs.zh: 有助於政府與組織規劃未來一年。

paragraphs.en: This describes the presidency's assessment
paragraphs.zh: 這是輪值主席國所作的評估，

paragraphs.en: of what the agreement can achieve.
paragraphs.zh: 說明協議有望達成的效果。

paragraphs.en: The agreement also leaves €710.1 million available
paragraphs.zh: 協議也保留7億1,010萬歐元的可用額度，

paragraphs.en: below the relevant spending limits.
paragraphs.zh: 且仍在相關支出上限之內。

paragraphs.en: According to the Council,
paragraphs.zh: 理事會表示，

paragraphs.en: this room is intended to help the EU
paragraphs.zh: 這份餘裕旨在協助歐盟

paragraphs.en: respond to needs that cannot be predicted.
paragraphs.zh: 回應無法事先預測的需求。

paragraphs.en: Planning therefore involves more than selecting current priorities.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，規劃不只是選定眼前的優先事項，

paragraphs.en: It also means preserving some capacity
paragraphs.zh: 也意味著保留部分應變能力，

paragraphs.en: for circumstances that may change.
paragraphs.zh: 以因應可能改變的情勢。

paragraphs.en: The annual plan sits within a larger framework.
paragraphs.zh: 這份年度計畫處於更大的架構之中。

paragraphs.en: The EU's current long-term budget covers 2021 to 2027,
paragraphs.zh: 歐盟目前的長期預算涵蓋2021年至2027年，

paragraphs.en: making this its final annual budget.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，2027年是這套架構的最後一份年度預算。

paragraphs.en: The framework sets spending ceilings
paragraphs.zh: 這個架構設定支出上限，

paragraphs.en: and helps keep yearly decisions connected to shared priorities.
paragraphs.zh: 並協助每年的決策持續配合共同的優先事項。

paragraphs.en: It also includes arrangements for flexibility,
paragraphs.zh: 同時也設有彈性安排，

paragraphs.en: because a fixed plan must still handle unexpected challenges.
paragraphs.zh: 因為固定的計畫仍然必須應對意外挑戰。

paragraphs.en: However, a negotiated agreement is not the final procedural step.
paragraphs.zh: 不過，談判達成協議並不是程序的最後一步。

paragraphs.en: The Council's November 11 release says
paragraphs.zh: 理事會11月11日的新聞稿指出，

paragraphs.en: both institutions have fourteen days to approve the deal formally.
paragraphs.zh: 兩個機構有14天時間正式批准協議。

paragraphs.en: It expects Council endorsement on November 23.
paragraphs.zh: 新聞稿預期理事會將於11月23日通過。

paragraphs.en: That is an expected next step,
paragraphs.zh: 這是預期中的下一步，

paragraphs.en: not evidence that formal approval has already happened.
paragraphs.zh: 並不代表正式批准已經完成。

paragraphs.en: The deal therefore combines a spending plan,
paragraphs.zh: 因此，這項協議結合了支出計畫、

paragraphs.en: a timetable, and space for uncertainty.
paragraphs.zh: 時程安排與因應不確定性的餘裕。

paragraphs.en: Its headline totals become more meaningful
paragraphs.zh: 其主要總額會變得更有意義，

paragraphs.en: when promises, payments, and approval are distinguished clearly.
paragraphs.zh: 前提是清楚區分資金承諾、實際支付與批准程序。

paragraphs.en: For people following European affairs,
paragraphs.zh: 對關注歐洲事務的人來說，

paragraphs.en: those distinctions help explain
paragraphs.zh: 這些差異有助於說明

paragraphs.en: what the negotiators have achieved
paragraphs.zh: 談判代表已達成哪些成果，

paragraphs.en: and what still remains to be completed.
paragraphs.zh: 以及還有哪些步驟尚待完成。

accounting.meaning: 會計的；accounting distinction指會計上的區分

are.meaning: 是；也可作被動語態的助動詞

quiz.question: Which statement best summarizes the article?

choices.text: The EU has completed every approval step for a new seven-year budget.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。協議涉及2027年年度預算，並非一份新的七年預算；第七段也說正式批准仍是下一步。

choices.text: Negotiators have agreed on an annual spending plan, but formal approval is still required.
choices.explanation: 正確。第一段說已就2027年預算達成協議，第七段指出兩個機構仍須正式批准。

choices.text: The EU has replaced commitments with a single payment fund.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。文章明確區分承諾額度與支付額度，並未表示其中一項取代另一項。

choices.text: All money in the agreement is reserved for research projects.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第四段列出農漁業、教育、研究、企業及基礎設施等多種用途，研究不是唯一項目。

quiz.explanation: 主旨須同時掌握「達成談判協議」與「批准程序尚未完成」。第一段交代年度預算協議，第七段則清楚說明正式批准的時限與預期步驟，因此第二個選項最完整。

evidence.quote: European Union negotiators reached a deal on the bloc's budget for 2027.
However, a negotiated agreement is not the final procedural step. The Council's November 11 release says both institutions have fourteen days to approve the deal formally.

quiz.question: What can be inferred from the explanation of commitments and payments?

choices.text: Every commitment must be fully paid in the year it is agreed.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第二段指出資金可能稍後才支付，第三段也用跨年度研究計畫作假設說明。

choices.text: A larger payment total proves that more new projects have been promised that year.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。支付可能用於履行過去年度的義務，因此不能據此判定當年度作出了更多新承諾。

choices.text: The research project in the example has already received a specific award in this budget.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第三段明確標示為假設例子，並非新預算中某筆特定補助。

choices.text: Some payments in a budget year may fulfil promises made in previous years.
choices.explanation: 正確。第二段直接說明支付額度涵蓋過去年度已同意承擔的義務。

quiz.explanation: 承諾與支付可能發生在不同年度。第二段說明支付可履行較早作出的義務，第三段的假設例子再說明計畫執行與撥款可能跨越數年。因此，不能把支付總額直接當成當年度的新承諾。

evidence.quote: Payments cover money due during the budget year, including obligations agreed in earlier years.
Payments could follow as that work progresses. This is an illustration of the accounting distinction, not a description of a particular award in the newly negotiated budget.

quiz.question: What does the room left below spending limits suggest about the budget approach?

choices.text: It combines planning for known priorities with some capacity to respond to unforeseen needs.
choices.explanation: 正確。第四段列出既定計畫，第五段則說明保留的餘裕用來回應無法事先預測的需求。

choices.text: It guarantees that no unexpected challenges will occur.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。保留應變能力是為了因應未知需求，並不能保證不會出現挑戰。

choices.text: It means the agreed programmes no longer need funding.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第四段仍說協議將支持多種計畫，保留餘裕並不代表取消原有資金需求。

choices.text: It removes the need for the institutions to approve the agreement.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第五段的應變餘裕與第七段的正式批准是不同事項，前者不會免除後者。

quiz.explanation: 第五段說，支出上限內保留的額度有助於因應無法預測的需求；第四段則說協議支持多種已知領域。綜合來看，這種安排同時照顧既定規劃與未來變化，而非保證不會發生意外。

evidence.quote: They include farming and fishing communities, as well as education, research, businesses, and infrastructure.
According to the Council, this room is intended to help the EU respond to needs that cannot be predicted.
